alignments.note: Connective δέ rendered by the verse-opening And.
Circumstantial participle rendered as a finite clause; the supplied subject he is a rule 7/9 helper and the preverb ἀνα- is realized by up inside the verb's own unit under rule 106.
The supplied juncture and is a rule 88/29 helper on the finite verb it introduces, not on the preceding participle.

Article governing a substantival adjective takes the determiner and the supplied nominal men under rules 49 and 102, headed on the supplied nominal; the discontinuity across rich is permitted by rule 15.
Substantival adjective keeps only its own bare word, the supplied noun having gone to the article under rule 102.
Attributive participle rendered as a finite relative clause; relativizer and copula are rule 7 and rule 9 helpers on the participle.
Genitive pronoun carries the English possessive.
Determiner slot displaced by the possessive their, which belongs to αὐτῶν under rule 20.
Expressed preposition realized by into under rule 36.

review_notes: SBLGNT.LUK.21.1.v001 is underdetermined and the projection carries r00-base; both readings are compatible with the ASV's wording, so no rule 97 question arises.
The ASV's marginal alternative rendering (and they were rich) would restructure the clause; the text rendering is aligned here.
